description: The Commercial Outdoor Battery Cabinet features a new structural design, perfectly compatible with the EverCore series energy storage inverters. It supports various applications including grid-connected, hybrid grid-connected/off-grid, and pure off-grid systems. The modular battery cabinet design allows flexible capacity expansion with convenient installation and maintenance. The cabinet integrates a dual cooling system with fans and air conditioning. Featuring explosion-proof construction, it ensures safety and reliability, delivering high return on investment for customers.
